# <Engineering subject> (SDE)

Status: working engineering baseline

## Purpose

This Software Development Environment document defines one part of the engineering
environment used to develop, build, test, document or review the software system.

It defines engineering mechanisms and conventions. It does not define product behaviour
or implementation-step scope.

## Terms and abbreviations

- **SDE** — Software Development Environment
- **CI** — Continuous Integration
<!-- Add only engineering terms that materially help the reader. -->

## Relationship to other documents

The SDP defines project-wide development direction and the SIP defines implementation
sequence. SDE documents define the environments, repositories, tooling and engineering
mechanisms used to execute that work.

The SVP/VTS define verification strategy and cases. Product specifications and design
documents remain the source of product behaviour and architecture.
